findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: docs/requirements/decisions/managed-cross-provider-cli-execution.md:120-123 and docs/host-run-usage.md:444-447 promise that a dead supervisor with a live provider group retains admission until the PGID is confirmed absent. However packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:2126-2141 deliberately persists provider identity before transferring the slot, and packages/main/src/core/provider-process-registry.ts:156-165 reclaims any valid untransferred slot as soon as its worker PID dies because providerProcessGroupIsolated/providerPgid are absent. The ordering smoke confirms this exposed state at packages/main/src/tasks/managed-host-run-admission-order-smoke.ts:79-88. If the worker dies in that handoff window, the still-live provider group can lose its capacity slot and a contender can be admitted, contradicting the documented fail-closed admission guarantee.
